name: Great Omari Mosque
specialization: Oldest mosque in Gaza - 1400 years old built on ancient temple site
introduction: Gaza's largest and oldest mosque. Built in 7th century on site of ancient Byzantine church which was built over pagan temple to Dagon. Named after Caliph Omar bin Khattab. Contained rare manuscripts and historical library. Destroyed by airstrike 8 December 2023. Only Mamluk-era minaret partially standing. Considered one of most important mosques in historical Palestine.

name: Church of Saint Porphyrius
specialization: Third oldest church in world - 1600 years old
introduction: One of world's oldest churches dating to 5th century. Named after Saint Porphyrius Bishop of Gaza 395-420 AD. Church compound struck 19 October 2023 killing 18 people including 10 from one family. Building in compound completely destroyed. About 500 people sheltering mostly Christians. Church building itself survived but severely damaged. Attacked again in 2024 with unexploded ordnance.
notes: Severe - Compound building destroyed church damaged

name: Holy Family Church
specialization: Only Catholic church in Gaza Strip
introduction: Only Catholic church in Gaza. Built in 1960s. Sheltered 648 displaced persons by December 2023. Mother and daughter Nahida and Samar Anton killed by Israeli sniper 16 December 2023 while walking to convent. Convent of Missionaries of Charity housing 54 disabled destroyed by tank fire. School hit 7 July 2024 killing 4 including Deputy Labor Minister. Solar panels water tanks destroyed. Operating under extreme conditions.
notes: Severe - Multiple attacks ongoing operations limited

name: Katib al-Wilaya Mosque
specialization: Mamluk-era mosque built beside Church of Saint Porphyrius
introduction: Historic Mamluk-era mosque (15th century) located beside Church of Saint Porphyrius symbolizing peaceful coexistence. Damaged in October strike on church compound. Completely destroyed in December 2023 airstrikes. Represented Gaza's interfaith heritage and architectural history.

name: Sayed al-Hashim Mosque
specialization: Contains tomb of Hashim ibn Abd Manaf Prophet Muhammad's grandfather
introduction: Important pilgrimage site containing tomb believed to be that of Hashim ibn Abd Manaf grandfather of Prophet Muhammad. Named UNESCO tentative World Heritage site. Significant religious and historical importance. Repeatedly targeted in November and December 2023. Extensive damage to structure and tomb area.

name: Khalid bin al-Walid Mosque
specialization: Named after renowned Islamic military commander
introduction: Large mosque in Khan Younis named after companion of Prophet Muhammad. Completely destroyed by airstrike 8 November 2023. Served as major worship center for southern Gaza. Rubble and debris all that remains.

name: Al-Hassan Mosque
introduction: Mosque in Tuffah neighborhood targeted during dawn prayers 16 November 2023. Direct airstrike killed 16 Palestinians worshipping. Complete destruction of structure. Community gathering center eliminated.

name: Al-Gharbi Mosque
introduction: One of first mosques destroyed in conflict. Hit by airstrike 9 October 2023. Complete structural destruction. Early indication of systematic targeting pattern.

name: Jaffa Mosque
introduction: Historic mosque in Deir al-Balah. Destroyed December 2023. Significant loss to central Gaza religious infrastructure. Served large community for over century.

name: Shuhada al-Aqsa Mosque
introduction: Mosque targeted during prayers October 2024 killing 26 people. Families sheltering in mosque. Women and children among victims. Complete destruction of building. Part of ongoing pattern of attacks on worship during prayer times.

name: Zofor Domri Mosque
introduction: Mosque in Shuja'iyya neighborhood bombed on three separate occasions then bulldozed by ground forces. Systematic destruction documented. Complete elimination of structure and surrounding area.
notes: Complete - Bombed three times then bulldozed

name: Al-Riad Mosque
introduction: Large mosque in Khan Younis heavily damaged by Israeli bombing 9 March 2024. Extensive structural damage rendering it non-functional. Continued attacks on southern Gaza religious sites.

name: Ibn Marwan Mosque
introduction: Ottoman-era mosque dating to 17th century. Significant historical architecture. Targeted November 2023. Major structural damage. Loss of historical heritage site.

name: Aybaki Mosque
introduction: Mamluk-era mosque from 14th century. Important architectural heritage. Completely destroyed December 2023. Irreplaceable historical loss.

name: Ibn Othman Mosque
introduction: Medieval mosque with centuries of history. Important for Islamic architectural heritage in Gaza. Extensively damaged November 2023. Rare historical structure lost.

name: Mahkamah Mosque
introduction: Historic Mamluk-era mosque associated with Islamic court system. Significant cultural and legal heritage site. Sustained major damage December 2023. Important link to Gaza's judicial history.

name: Sheikh Zakariyya Mosque
introduction: Historic mosque named after renowned Islamic scholar. Important religious education center. Targeted November 2023. Significant damage to structure and religious library.

name: Al-Shamah Mosque
introduction: Community mosque serving Gaza City neighborhood for over century. Destroyed December 2023. Complete loss of worship facility and community center.

name: St. Hilarion Monastery
specialization: UNESCO World Heritage site - oldest monastery in Holy Land
introduction: Ancient Christian monastery founded 329 AD. One of oldest Christian monasteries in world. UNESCO World Heritage tentative list site. Archaeological site damaged by bombardment and military operations. Fourth century mosaics and structures at risk. Represents early Christian heritage in region.

name: Gaza Baptist Church
introduction: Protestant church serving small Baptist community in Gaza. Damaged by strikes on surrounding area. Continues limited operations. Sheltering displaced families. Part of Gaza's diverse Christian heritage.

name: Abu Salim Mosque
introduction: One of the territory’s oldest places of worship
notes: Extensive - Damage to the courtyard and part of its main structure
